Summary: Request for a Quote and Risk Assessment Regarding Changing the D2S Authentication Method to OAuth
Creator: Yukari Hashimoto
Description:
MFTBCFFR-5876
*Background*
On 11-Jun-2026, an authentication issue occurred between FDP and CPI, which resulted in failure of SO Confirmation transmission to FDPs. The root cause was identified as the temporary lock of the SAP S User used for CPI authentication. 
As a preventive measure, the SAP/CPI team has proposed migrating the current authentication mechanism from S User-based authentication to OAuth authentication. According to the SAP team, the current approach relies on S User credentials and may be vulnerable to future issues such as password expiration, account lockout, or S User lifecycle changes. 
*Request*
Could the Siebel team please assess the feasibility of supporting OAuth authentication for the FDP-CPI integration and provide an effort estimate?
*Expected Deliverables*
Please provide:
# Feasibility assessment for OAuth implementation on the Siebel side.
# High-level solution approach and required design changes.
# Impact analysis on existing interfaces and runtime performance, if any.
# Development, testing, and deployment effort estimation.
# Assumptions, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites.
*Additional Information*
The SAP team has requested that runtime impact should be verified through testing rather than assumed, and is encouraging evaluation of OAuth as part of the initiative to reduce dependency on traditional authentication methods and S User management. |https://outlook.office365.com/owa/?ItemID=AAMkAGRjMmM5YTNkLTI4NjgtNGYzNS05MTg2LTYzMTk0MmVhNmUyYQBGAAAAAAAUgn7O6jW0Q7scy4hDumptBwBLWxn3UZn1QbKGaW8Qyj6KAAAAAAEMAABLWxn3UZn1QbKGaW8Qyj6KAACIP8L%2fAAA%3d&exvsurl=1&viewmodel=ReadMessageItem]

We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-6075, related to latest quote revision not reflected in SO.
Please find the summary below:
|\xad\xadインシデント番号|MFTBCFFR-6075|
|事象|最新の見積改訂内容が受注に反映されない。|
|RCA|調査の結果、受注は販売見積改訂 4までは正常に同期されていることを確認しました。
その後の最新改訂との同期処理中に、ユーザーが受注を更新したため、同期処理が停止されました。
その際、バックエンドには以下のエラーが出力されていました。
「ステップ 'Sync Sales Order' のサービス 'EAI Siebel Adapter'、 メソッド 'Synchronize' を実行中にエラーが発生しました。(SBL-BPR-00162) ビジネスコンポーネント 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (統合コンポーネント 'MF Order Item') のメソッド 'WriteRecord' で、検索条件が ' = "30"' のレコードが次のエラーを返しました : "選択されたデータは、取得後に他のユーザにより変更されました。そのまま続けてください。(SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)」
データベースを確認したところ、**明細 30（追加架装‐Additional Body）**を除くすべての明細は、Siebel スクリプトにより同一時刻に更新されており、正常に同期処理が実行されていることを確認しました。
\xa0
一方、明細 30（追加架装‐Additional Body）については、最終更新ソースおよび最終更新日が他の明細と異なっており、更新元がSiebel スクリプトではなく、アプリケーションユーザーとなっていました。また、この明細はバックエンドのCX_EAI_LOGSにも記録されていました。
\xa0
以上より、同期処理中にユーザーが追加架装の明細を手動で更新したため、Siebelが他ユーザーによる更新を検知し、同期処理を停止したことが原因と判断しております。
\xa0
その結果、最新の見積改訂内容が受注へ反映されませんでした。
\xa0
\xa0|
|復旧状況|対象データのリカバリーは完了しております。
\xa0
お手数ですが、ご確認をお願いいたします。|
|対応方針（Fix Plan）|バックエンドログからも、同期処理中にユーザーが同じレコードを更新したことが原因であることを確認しております。
\xa0
本事象は、ユーザーが同時に複数の操作を行った場合にのみ発生する非常に稀なケースです。
\xa0
現在はシステムは正常に動作しており、UAT環境でも正常動作を確認しております。そのため、システム改修は不要と判断しております。|
(English)
|\xad\xadIncident Number|MFTBCFFR-6075|
|Description|Latest quote revision not reflected in SO|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We investigated this issue and observed that the Sales Order was last successfully synced with the Sales Quote Revision number 4. The sync process for the latest quote revision stopped because the Sales Order was modified while the quote synchronization was in progress.
As a result, the following error was logged at the backend:
"ステップ 'Sync Sales Order'\xa0のサービス 'EAI Siebel Adapter'、\xa0メソッド 'Synchronize'\xa0を実行中にエラーが発生しました。(SBL-BPR-00162)
ビジネスコンポーネント 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (統合コンポーネント 'MF Order Item')\xa0のメソッド 'WriteRecord'\xa0で、検索条件が ' = "30"'\xa0のレコードが次のエラーを返しました : "選択されたデータは、取得後に他のユーザにより変更されました。そのまま続けてください。(SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)
From the database, we observed that all line items except *Line Number 30 (Additional Body)* were updated by the*Siebel Script* as part of the normal quote synchronization process. The*Last Updated* timestamp for these line items is also the same, confirming that the synchronization completed successfully for them.
However, for *Line Number 30 (Additional Body)*, both the *Last Updated Source* and the *Last Updated* timestamp are different from the other line items. Instead of showing the*Siebel Script* , it shows the application user who manually updated the record. The same line item is also referenced in the *CX_EAI_LOGS* backend error log.
This confirms that the Additional Body line item was manually modified by the user while the quote synchronization was in progress. Since the same record was updated during synchronization, Siebel detected that the record had been modified by another user and stopped the synchronization process, resulting in the*SBL-DAT-00523* error. Therefore, the latest quote revision was not reflected in the Sales Order.
\\
|
|Recovery status|The recovery has been completed for the affected record. Kindly verify.|
|Fix Plan|Our backend error logging clearly mentions that record was simultaneously modified by another user. It is a very rare occurrence where user performs two operations at the same time.
Currently the process is working fine, which can be tested on UAT as well. No fix required.|'}]

Thank you for your support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-6022, related to latest quote revision not reflected in Sales Order.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number\xa0|MFTBCFFR-6022|
|Description|The latest quote revision is not reflected in Sales Order.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We have investigated this issue and observed that the user created the first quote revision using model code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4'. After completing the quote, user proceeded to create the corresponding sales order from this quote.
After that user revised the sales quote and in second revision, the user deleted the line item having model code as 'FBAV0B22S00G-4' and created a new quote line item in quote items using a different Model Code 'FBAV0B22S00G-4-G830'.
When user completed the sales quote revision 2 and attempted to synchronize the sales quote with the Sales Order, the line number reference for original quote line item had been lost and the synchronization process could not be completed.
However the user continued to revise the quote upto revision number 5, but the sales order remained in synchronized only with revision 1. 
For the recovery, we updated the line number of the new created quote line item with Model Code as 'FBAV0B22S00G-4-G830' to match the line number of the previously created item. After this update, the Sales Order was successfully synchronized with the latest quote revision.
To avoid this issue, users are advised to update the Model Code on the existing quote line item instead of deleting the entire line item and creating a new one. This preserves the line number reference required for successful synchronization.
Since this is a case of user misoperation, no fix is required.|

In the reported case, a Sales Order was initially created with a *Required Quantity of 3*, and the system correctly generated three child Sales Orders. Later, the Quote was revised, and the *Required Quantity was changed from 3 to 1*. After all child Sales Orders were cancelled, the user attempted to perform Sales Posting using the parent Sales Order. However, Sales Posting failed because the backend still recognized the parent Sales Order as being associated with child Sales Orders.
In the SC Production environment, this scenario cannot occur because the *Required Quantity* becomes read-only once a Sales Order has been created. In contrast, FDP currently allows the Required Quantity to be modified after Sales Order creation, enabling a business scenario that is not supported in SC.
We have considered the following two approaches to address this issue.
*Option 1*
Update the backend logic so that when the Required Quantity is changed to *1*, the relationship between the parent Sales Order and its child Sales Orders is automatically removed.
This approach allows the current FDP business process to continue without any operational changes.
*Option 2*
Modify FDP to follow the same behavior as SC Production.
Once a Sales Order has been created:
* The *Required Quantity* becomes read-only.
* Users cannot modify the Required Quantity through Quote revisions.
* If a quantity change is required, users must create a new Quote and a new Sales Order.
Since this approach prevents data inconsistencies and aligns FDP with the standard SC business process, *we recommend Option 2*.

|Root Cause (RCA)|We have investigated this issue and observed that the Sales Order was last synced with quote revision 8. Sync process for further quote revision stopped due to Multi browser activity. At the time of sync of NV Quote from rev 8 to rev 9, the user was creating an invoice in the NV Sale Order (Invoice#: C000105274).

ビジネスコンポーネント 'MF RF Order Entry - Line Items' (統合コンポーネント 'MF Order Item') のメソッド 'WriteRecord' で、検索条件が ' = "47"' のレコードが次のエラーを返しました : "選択されたデータは、取得後に他のユーザにより変更されました。そのまま続けてください。(SBL-DAT-00523)"(SBL-EAI-04451)"

\xa0
|インシデント番号|MFTBCFFR-5858|
|事象内容|見積の最新改訂版が受注に反映されない|
|RCA|調査の結果、対象の受注は見積改訂版8までは正常に同期されていましたが、それ以降の改訂版については同期処理が停止していたことを確認いたしました。
NV見積をRev.8からRev.9へ同期するタイミングで、ユーザーが同じ受注に対して請求書作成（Invoice#：C000105274）を実施していました。
その結果、バックエンドで以下のエラーが発生し、同期処理が停止しました。
"ステップ 'Sync Sales Order' のサービス 'EAI Siebel Adapter'、 メソッド 'Synchronize' を実行中にエラーが発生しました。(SBL-BPR-00162)
--

システム不具合ではないため、現時点でプログラム修正は不要と判断しております。|

We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-5739, related to delivery approval error in UV SO due to incomplete Activity.
Please find the summary below:
{color:#ffffff}__{color}
|Incident Number\xa0|MFTBCFFR-5739|
|Description|delivery approval error in UV SO due to incomplete Activity|
|Root Cause (RCA)|Please note that the Activity status in UV Sales Order is set to 'Work Completed' when Job Card is closed. After that user can manually set the status of Activity to 'Closed'. In both these cases where Activity status is 'Work Completed' or 'Closed', the Activity is considered to be completed.
So, the status of Activity being set as 'Closed' is not the issue in this case.
We have replicated this issue on FDP UAT-1 environment. Please find below the user steps:
1.) User created a Activity in UV Sales Order and created a Job Card for this Activity.
2.) User then set the status of Job Card to 'Canceled'.
3.) The Activity for this Job Card remained in UV Sales Order with status as 'Open'. User manually updated the status of this Activity to 'Closed'.
While completing the delivery approval request, the system check for he valid active Job Card linked to the Activity. In the affected record, since the Activity status is 'Closed' but the mapped JC was already cancelled, the system could not find a valid active JC. Due to this validation failure error message was displayed.
In this case user should manually update the status of this Activity to 'Cancel Request'.|
|Recovery status|Recovery has been completed.|
|Fix Plan|No fix required. When user Cancel the Job Card, the status of the Activity linked to this Job Card should be manually set to 'Cancel Request'.|
If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
Regards
Sunaina Gill"}]

Creator: Makoto Ikezawa
Description:
This is a case from Shikoku.
K000442780 : The payer has been corrected due to an order change.
Regarding the invoice for the end of April:
The amount is included in the invoice cover sheet, but it was not printed in the invoice details.
-----
0000807603                            0000201611
15th of the month closing ⇒ End of month closing

We have checked for this Change Order# K000442780. It is not present in the bulk invoice data for the end of April month.
The cause being, This change order is related to a Payer Change. 
The Payer is changed from\xa0
0000807603 \xa0 => 0000201611
15th of the month closing ⇒ End of month closing
For the bulk invoice data, end of month closing is processed on the basis of closing date of billing account of the Job Card.
Which in this case is 0000807603 and this account has the closing of 15th. Therefore this change order was not sent in the bulk invoice of the EOM of April.
We will share with you the recovery method soon.
Best Regards,

This issue has already been fixed and counter measures taken where we have created a separate logic clone for retriggering and recovery and has been handled through MFTBCFFR-5711.

Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2026-05-01T05:13:00', 'author': 'Ravi', 'text': 'Thank you for your continued support.
We have acknowledged the incident and started working on it.
Meanwhile, please let us know for further assistance.
Regards,
Ravi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-08T11:52:00', 'author': 'Saad', 'text': 'Thank you for your support and cooperation.
We have analysed this issue and would like to share with you the root cause.
As per our analysis, we have figured out the steps, leading to cause of this incident. They are listed as follows: -
*1)* Initially, the spreadsheet was in the status *Spreadsheet Requested.*
*2)* In SR# 5709, Recovery was performed and the status of the spreadsheet was changed back to *Spreadsheet Created.* As part of recovery, the *approval history was removed from the spreadsheet* as well. The request entity was not removed from the Inbox item of the concerned approver.
*3)* So, the next time when the user submitted an approval request, the approval history was not created in the spreadsheet, leading to an illusion of the approval never being sent, but the approval request item was still present in the inbox of the approver.
*4)* Now, when the approver approved the request entity, the status of spreadsheet changed to *Spreadsheet Approved.*
*Sheet#* 1-502819545 (UAT1)
We have replicated this issue following the steps mentioned above.
We will share with you the fix plan as soon as we device one.
Meanwhile, let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Saad'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-11T00:40:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for sharing RCA for this issue.
We need to create JV for this Spread sheet.
Any plan to recovery this Spread sheet?
Miyauchi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-11T07:14:00', 'author': 'Saad', 'text': 'Thank you for your support and cooperation.
We are looking for a recovery plan for creating the required JVs,
We will share it with you soon.
Best Regards,
Saad'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-12T10:06:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support and cooperation
We have successfully created the JVs for the 37 Job Cards Associated with this Insurance Spreadsheet (In total 148 Journal Voucher Items). 
Please find attached the recovery data, and provide the approval.
We will link the data for batch processing there onwards.
Do let us know in case of any issue or query found.
Best Regards
Saad'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-12T23:58:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
Please share permanent fix plan.
Miyauchi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-14T11:24:00', 'author': 'Saad', 'text': 'Thank you for your support and cooperation.
Upon in depth analysis and search for a permanent fix plan. It has been found out that there is no need of the implementation of any fix plan.
The system is behaving as expected.
Due to the recovery performed in SR#5709, the natural flow pattern of approval history was disturbed.
To handle the above, we are required to update the recovery procedure required for this type of cases.
This recovery procedure will require us to deactivate any pending approval requests to the designated approvers.
This will automatically prevent any hidden approvals in case of recovery performed on any spreadsheet.
We therefore request you to help us close this incident as the system is working as expected and so this issue cannot be classified as a bug, also let us know of the Journal Voucher recoveries required, for which we have created the data and shared it with you.
Please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Saad'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-14T23:41:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
Understood the issue will not happen with normal process.
Please update the recovery procedue and close this incident.
Miyauchi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-15T04:57:00', 'author': 'Saad', 'text': 'Thank you for your support and cooperation.
We will do the needful and update the recovery procedure for instances of similar kind in the future.
For now, we are closing this incident.
Best Regards,
Saad'}]

Summary: PT_The D2S Invoice mismatch screen is very slow both when opening it and when exporting.
Creator: Masahiro Hata
Description:
When opening it for the first time, PDQ “01 アンマッチ(全件)” is applied by default, and it is very slow. Although the screen does eventually open, the export process afterward is extremely slow and cannot be completed.
While some slowness when opening the screen is understandable, please check the cause of the slow export performance and see if it can be improved.
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2026-04-17T05:24:00', 'author': 'Soham Modi', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
We have acknowledged this issue and are working on it. We’ll provide an update shortly.
Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-04-23T07:12:00', 'author': 'Soham Modi', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
RCA:
The slowness observed in loading the ‘D2S Invoice Mismatch’ screen is due to the following reasons:
1. The PDQ is taking time to load since it is always scanning the given conditions in the whole data present.
2. The system sort records based on _D2S SO Number_, _D2S Line Number_, and _Part Number_. Since these fields are not indexed, the sorting process takes longer resulting in the delay.
Proposed Fix Plan:
1. We can restrict the PDQ to fetch data for the last 30 days to reduce the data volume.
2. We can create index in the table for the columns that are being used in the sorting to optimize query execution.
Please confirm the fix plan so that we can proceed with the fix of this issue.
Please also let me know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-04-23T07:31:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
It is not desirable to add a “last 30 days” condition to PDQ. 
This is because, on this screen, unmatched records from *all periods* need to be extracted and exported so that users can review the causes and take appropriate action.
Regards,
Hata'}, {'timestamp': '2026-04-28T06:18:00', 'author': 'Soham Modi', 'text': 'Thanks for your continued support.
We understood that the condition must not be updated to 30-Days. So, for fix, we will be creating index for the columns used in the sorting so that the query can be optimized and loading time can be minimized.
Meanwhile please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-01T06:55:00', 'author': 'Tanish Chauhan', 'text': 'Dear Hata San,
Thank you for your support.
We have implemented the indexing on the table in UAT based on the sort order.
Kindly allow us to proceed with deploying these changes to production. We will verify the performance in production, as UAT does not have sufficient data to properly assess the slowness.
Please provide your approval to proceed.
Regards,
Tanish Chauhan'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-01T07:20:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
Please release to Prod.
Regards,
Hata'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-15T02:59:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
We checked the slowness issue after the release'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-20T13:12:00', 'author': 'Soham Modi', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
Regarding the additional fixes, we are currently considering the below improvements to enhance the loading performance of the D2S Invoice Mismatch screen:
# Improve the existing index by adding additional columns based on the query patterns and columns identified from the logs.
# Currently, the sorting is being handled in the backend, which results in multiple sorting operations being performed on the table. Instead, we are planning to handle the sorting order through the PDQ itself to reduce the loading time and improve overall performance.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-21T01:04:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
What sorting conditions are currently configured?
Basically, I believe it would be fine even if no sorting is applied.
Regards,
Hata'}, {'timestamp': '2026-05-22T05:41:00', 'author': 'Soham Modi', 'text': 'Thanks for your continued support.
The current sorting conditions are based on the following three columns in sequence:
D2S Order Number → Sales Order Item → Part Number.
As per your confirmation that the sorting condition can be removed, we will proceed with the required fix accordingly to optimize and improve the screen loading performance.
Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any further queries.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi'}, {'timestamp': '2026-06-09T11:36:00', 'author': 'Soham Modi', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.

,

We would like to share the analysis details for incident MFTBCFFR-5488, regarding the sync issue in the UV Sales Order.
Issue:
The Profit of the Sales Order and the latest Quote revision are not aligned.
Root Cause Analysis (RCA):
The issue occurred because Sub Quote 1-7DUHTZ was synced to the UV Sales Quote after the sales quote had already been approved and synced to the Sales Order. This was possible because the "Update Customer Quote" button on the Sub Quote detail view remains active even after the Sales Quote status is set to "Initial Approval Completed".
We have successfully replicated this issue in the FDP UAT-1 environment (Reference Record: UV Quote#: 1-6UW1UZ, UV SO#: E001303159).
Steps to Reproduce:
# Create a UV Sales Quote and add an Activity.
# Create a Job Card from the Activity.
# In the UV Sales Quote, click 'Generate Approval' and proceed to create the UV Sales Order.
# In the Job Card, complete the Work Order and create a Service Quote.
# Click "Update Sales Quote" button in the Service Quote to create a Sub Quote under the UV Sales Quote.
# Observe that the UV Sales Quote status is "Initial Approval Completed", but the "Update Customer Quote" button remains active.
# Click "Update Customer Quote" to sync Service items to the UV Sales Quote.
# Note that these items are not synced to the UV Sales Order.
Fix Plan:
Once the UV Sales Quote status is "Initial Approval Completed", if a user attempts to click the "Update Customer Quote" button in the Sub Quote tab, a validation message will be displayed:
"Sales Quote has already been completed."
Recovery Status: Recovery has been completed.

Best Regards,
Atul Yadav"}, {'timestamp': '2026-02-09T14:20:00', 'author': 'Ayaz', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
This issue is replicable on UAT, please follow these steps to replicate it on UAT-1 ->
1) Create a New Job Card
 2) Create a work order and add Line Items (Parts, Labor and Lubrication) in it.
 3) Create/Sync Quote and make the quote customer approved.
 4) Now Labor list price will be same in JCO and Quote.
 5) Go to Work Order Line Items cancel one of the labor.
 6) In quote the price of cancelled labor is removed, but in JCO price of cancelled labor is still there. so, there is a difference in
 \xa0 Labor List Price at Quote and JCO.
 7) Now close the Job Card without syncing service quote to JCO
\xa0
 At this point, we can see a price mismatch:
 Quote shows the reduced labor price
 JCO still shows the higher labor price.
\xa0
 We have performed thorough analysis of this issue and found the root cause:-
RCA:
 When a user cancels any line item (labor/parts/lubricants) in the Work Order, the system immediately updates the total price in the Quote.
 However, the JCO price is not updated at the same time.
 The JCO price is updated only when a quote is created and customer approved after the cancellation of Line Items.
 So, if a line item is cancelled after quote is customer approved, and user does not create and customer approved a new quote but he directly closes the Job Card. Then the JCO continues to display the old price, while the Quote shows the updated price.
 This is why a price difference appears between the Quote and the JCO.
\xa0
Fix Plan:
We are currently evaluating different possible fix options for this issue.
 Please allow us to schedule a meeting with you, so we can discuss the available approaches and decide on the most suitable fix plan.
 Meanwhile Let us know in case of any query.
Regards,

本件、FDP ChugokuでAssessment RequestのStatusが’Vehicle for Quotation’ですが、他のStatusへUpdateできません。
その為、Userは‘Cancelled’のStatusにUpdateしたいのですが、その前の Statusの‘Assessment Completed’にDirect Update出来ない状況です。

Meanwhile we are working on the RCA and will update you soon.

Regards
Sunaina Gill"}, {'timestamp': '2026-02-10T02:33:00', 'author': None, 'text': '|mailto:hideaki.shiromoto@daimlertruck.com] San,
 いつも大変お世話になっております。
 インシデント*につきまして、調査結果は以下の通りです。
|インシデント番号|MFTBCFFR-5317|
|事象内容|査定依頼（Assessment Request）のステータスが「完了（Completed）」または「キャンセル（Cancelled）」に更新できない。|
|RCA|本件は、在庫外車両（Unstock Vehicle）\xa0に関する査定依頼のケースです。
\xa0
当該査定依頼は、ユーザーID D8HIHARA（役割：Branch-Sales-Staff）により作成されました。
承認後、査定依頼のステータスは\xa0「Submitted to UV」に更新されました。
\xa0
その後、UVスタッフが査定依頼を処理する際に、
見積用車両引当区分「Quotation Vehicle Allocation」フラグを「Y」\xa0に設定したことで、
本査定依頼は\xa0在庫外車両（Unstock Vehicle）\xa0のケースとして判定されました。
\xa0
既存の機能では、査定依頼が Branch-Sales-Staff\xa0により作成された場合、
以下のステータスのみが編集可能となります。
\xa0
Submitted to UV
\xa0
JAAI Assessment In Progress
\xa0
Assessment In Progress
\xa0
Rejected
\xa0
In Progress
\xa0
Assessment Completed
\xa0
上記以外のステータスに設定された場合、査定依頼は\xa0読み取り専用（Read-Only）\xa0となります。
\xa0
本件では、査定依頼のステータスが\xa0「Vehicle for Quotation」\xa0に設定されたため、
ステータスが\xa0読み取り専用（Read-Only）\xa0となり、UVスタッフが\xa0「Completed」へ更新できない\xa0状態となっていました。|
|リカバリー状況|ご指示に基づき、2月3日\xa0にリカバリー対応を実施し、
査定依頼のステータスを\xa0「Cancelled」\xa0に更新済みです。|
|修正プラン|FDP本番環境全体を確認した結果、本件と同様の事象は他に発生しておらず、
現象自体は既存機能どおり操作していることを確認しております。
\xa0
ただし、本件を踏まえ、以下の修正を実施予定です。
\xa0
査定依頼が Branch-Sales-Staff\xa0により作成された場合であっても、
ステータスが\xa0「Vehicle for Quotation」\xa0に設定された際は、
引き続きステータスを\xa0編集可能（Editable）\xa0とするようロジックを変更します。
\xa0
本対応方針についてご承認をいただき次第、UAT環境への修正対応\xa0を進めさせていただきます。|
|UAT実施予定日|2026年2月10日|
\xa0
何かご不明な点がございましたらご連絡ください。

Summary: CMVM_"Name of Personnel in charge of service" contains an invalid value.

Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2026-01-06T07:11:00', 'author': 'Soham', 'text': "Thanks for your support.

Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Soham"}, {'timestamp': '2026-01-06T09:44:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for you support and cooperation.
We have performed our analysis on the issue and would like to provide you with the root cause along with answering the questions given.
*1) Why this vehicle data was registered ?*
These vehicles are created from the *TCB01* files. By default, the\xa0*Name of Personnel in charge of service*\xa0is set to be *Administrator*. For this name the *Code of personnel in charge of service* is blank in the master data. Since, this is a default setting, this should not be characterized into an issue.
*2) Solutions to prevent this issue*
Since, this is a agreed upon default setting. We believe the solution to prevent this issue is to change the default value as per the business requirement.
*3) How to recover existing data ?*
If business decides to change the default value. Data patching could be performed to recover the data with the newly decided default value.
Please do let us know in case of any additional query
Best Regards
Saad'}, {'timestamp': '2026-01-06T12:42:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'いつも大変お世話になっております。
\xa0
本件につきまして、弊社にて調査を実施いたしましたので、原因およびご質問への回答を以下のとおりご報告いたします。
\xa0
1）当該車両データが登録された理由について
該当の車両は、TCB01 ファイルを通じて作成されたものです。
システムの既定仕様として、「サービス担当者名」は デフォルトで管理者（Administrator）として設定されております。

Description:
SO#: E000134270
本件、Registration RequestのTax Confirmation ButtonをClickedすると下記のError MessageがPop-upします。
Pop-upする原因を教えてください。
 
他のCaseと違うのはSOのLine Itemsの２つが0円ですが、Registration RequestのLine items - をInputしたAmountは０円ではありません。
通常、Registration CompletedするとSOのLine ItemsへSyncされます。

Best Regards,
Soham"}, {'timestamp': '2025-12-26T05:33:00', 'author': None, 'text': "Thank you for your continued support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the Incident MFTBCFFR-5180, related to Tax amount finalization error.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number\xa0|MFTBCFFR-5180|
|Description|Tax amount finalization error|
|User Steps|Step 1: In the related UV Sales Quote, user has manually changed the items of Tax and Expenses and updated one Expense Item to 'Tax'.
Step 2: User created a Sales Order.
Step 3: User created an Invoice and completed it.
Step 4: User created a Registration Request and clicked on 'Finalize Tax Amount' button.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We have successfully replicated this issue in UAT-1 environment (Reference Record: UV Sales Quote : 1-6XPN5P revision 5, UV Sales Order : E001300882).
When an invoice is created, the status of line items with Type as 'Tax' is automatically updated to Invoiced. However, a manually updated line item with Part Number 'YN6M' and Type as 'Tax' did not have its status changed to Invoiced.
During Tax Finalization, the status of all line items having Type as 'Tax', including manually updated ones (such as part number YN6M), must be set to Invoiced.|
|Recovery status|Please note that we have checked and found that no such case of manually updating the Expense Line item to 'Tax' has been observed in any FDP Production Environment.
As this is a case of user misoperation, so no recovery is required.
Kindly ask the user to revise the UV Sales Quote, and update the correct expense line items.\xa0|
|Fix Plan|NA|
As this is a case of user mis-operation, we would like to proceed with closing this Jira ticket.
If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
Best Regards
Sunaina Gill"}]

\xa0
|Incident Number\xa0|MFTBCFFR-5145|
|Description|UV FDP四国 注文書と販売見積の金額が違う（注文書の金額が合っていない）|
|Root Cause (RCA)|The amount shown in Quotation BIP has Discount\xa0 amount of -819798(MF Vehicle Discount Amount) while the amount in Order Sheet BIP has Discount amount of -60000(MF UV Discount).
 Please find attached image highlighting the different field mappings.|
|Recovery status|We will update Discount to 819798 so that the correct amount is reflected in Order Sheet BIP. This Recovery will be completed after approval from Shiromoto San.|
|Fix Plan|
 If required we will update the logic and add MF Vehicle Discount Amount to Final amount in Order Sheet BIP.|
|Next update|22nd December,2025|
 Please let us know in case of any questions or queries.
Regards,
 Atul Yadav'}, {'timestamp': '2025-12-23T05:47:00', 'author': 'Atul Yadav', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

Since this is not a bug, please allow us to reject this incident.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Regards,
Atul Yadav'}]

|Incident Number|MFTBCFFR-5069|
|Description|A delivery approval error was displayed in NV Sales Order, thus preventing the user from completing the process.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|Please note that both affected NV Sales Order# A000009087 and A000011464, have product class as 'Trailer'. In this case, when the Sales Order is Approved, a purchase order having type as 'Trailer & Forklift' is automatically created.\xa0
Subsequently, when the status of this Purchase Order is updated to "Ordered", the system creates a new Vehicle record and populates its Vehicle ID in both the Purchase Order and the corresponding Sales Order.
For the affected records in Wakayama Production, the Sales Orders were approved successfully and the corresponding Purchase Orders were generated. When the Purchase Orders status was updated to "Ordered", new Vehicle records were created as expected.
However, the issue occurred because the Vehicle Id of this newly created Vehicle was populated correctly in the Purchase Order but was not populated in the corresponding Sales Order. During the Delivery Approval process, the system validates the Vehicle information between the Purchase Order and Sales Order. Due to the Vehicle ID mismatch, the validation failed and the Delivery Approval error message was displayed.|
|Recovery status|Completed|
|Fix Plan|We have reviewed this issue at the code level and confirmed that there is no defect in the current implementation and the process is working as expected. We attempted to replicate this issue in UAT environment but this issue could not be replicated.
We have monitored this issue over the past few months, and no recurrence has been observed on any production environment.
Also please note that the affected Purchase Orders were completed in March 2025 whereas the issue was reported in December 2025. Due to the significant time gap , some information is not available to access the issue. As a result, while we were able to identify that the Delivery Approval error was caused by a Vehicle ID mismatch between the Purchase Order and Sales Order, we do not currently have sufficient information to determine why the Vehicle ID was not populated in the Sales Order at that time.\xa0
We will continue to monitor the system, and if a similar issue occurs in the future, we will investigate it immediately and take the necessary corrective actions.

Creator: Yuji Yoshihara
Description:
Hi Service Team,
@Iwate/Okinawa/Chugoku-PROD
Payment terms are not included in the Service Purchase Order Sheet.
However, payment terms are included in Sikoku/Wakayama's BIP for the same Wave-3.
Please investigate the following.
(1) Payment terms are included in the Check for UAT4-8, but please investigate why they were not included in PROD.
(2) Please investigate why they are different in the FDP for Wave-3 as well.
Regards,
Service Yoshihara
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2025-11-26T10:31:00', 'author': 'Abhinav', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

*RCA*:
*(1) Reason for Payment Terms were included in UAT4–8 but not reflected in PROD:*
 The Payment Condition values displayed in the BIP are based on the PO Sheet master. During the initial setup for Wave-3, the master data for these Payment Conditions was not provided by biz.
 When the incident *MFTBCFFR-4978* was raised, the missing values were added across all UAT environments, and the master data was uploaded based on the values that were already present in *OKAYAMA-PROD*. However, since the required master data was not available during the initial PROD deployment, the Payment Terms were not reflected in the Wave-3 PROD environments.
*(2) Reason for differences across FDP environments (Wave-3 & Chugoku):*
 In the Shikoku and Wakayama PROD environments, hardcoded Payment Condition values already exist in the BIP configuration. Therefore, Payment Terms appear only in these specific FDP environments.
 In contrast, other FDPs i.e.\xa0*Iwate, Okinawa, and Chugoku,*\xa0do not have such hardcoded values, which results in the observed differences in Payment Term display across Wave-3 PROD environments.
*Fix and release plan:*
As discussed in the meeting, after the issue was fixed on UAT and since all the UAT environments are in sync now, we are planning to release the UAT changes to PROD on *29th November after business hours*.
Kindly review and approve the PROD release for the respective FDPs so that we can proceed with the changes to PROD on *29th November*.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Soham'}, {'timestamp': '2025-11-29T06:44:00', 'author': 'Service Yoshihara', 'text': 'Hi Soham san
Thanks for your support.

Master and BIP are linked.

Please deploy to PROD.

*RCA*: The performance issue in the “Order Confirmation Shipment” screen while using the PDQ '02_当月販売' was caused primarily by the query design. The PDQ uses the condition JulianMonth() = JulianMonth(Today()), which applies a function directly on the date column. This makes the condition non-searchable using indexes, preventing the database from using the index on and forcing a full table scan. Additionally, multiple OR conditions on and further increased query complexity, and the absence of row limits resulted in large data retrieval, slowing both screen loading and data export. Since the same PDQ logic is used across all FDP environments, the slowness was observed in all FDP-PROD except for FDP-Okayama where the PDQ does not exist.
We'll provide the detailed analysis on the ways for improving the load time for this screen soon since multiple parameters are involved. Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any query.

Summary: INS_eJIBAI not link to Siebel
Creator: Hajime Miyauchi
Description: Created new insurance order on eJIBAI but new order not created on Siebel.
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2025-11-05T06:37:00', 'author': 'Atul Yadav', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have acknowledged this incident and are working on it. We will update you as soon as we find the root cause.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav'}, {'timestamp': '2025-11-28T07:13:00', 'author': 'Atul Yadav', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We are working on replicating this issue on UAT with Gayatri San. We will update you as soon as we find the root cause.
Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any issue.
Regards,
Atul Yadav'}, {'timestamp': '2025-12-09T06:40:00', 'author': 'Divyesh Ghiya', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have thoroughly analyzed this issue, and our findings are as follows:
The user is creating an Insurance Order and then generating the Policy Number through the Ejibai interface. However, the Ejibai response is not being sent back to Siebel. Instead, the policy is created in Ejibai, and the user is manually updating the Liability Insurance Policy # field in the Insurance Order, as it is currently editable.
When the Policy Number is populated in the Insurance Order through the Ejibai response, the backend field User Key gets updated automatically. However, when the Policy Number is entered manually, the User Key remains null. Therefore, when that same policy is sent again from Ejibai to Siebel, the system does not find the original record (due to the missing User Key) and creates a duplicate order.
We successfully replicated this issue on UAT4 with the help of Gayatri-san. Please refer to the Insurance Order Q000037255 and its duplicate Q000037256.
Replication steps performed:
Step 1: Created an Insurance Order in Siebel and proceeded with policy creation on the Ejibai side.
Step 2: Manually updated the Liability Insurance Policy # in the Insurance Order instead of sending the response from the Ejibai interface.
Step 3: Sent the Policy Number again from Ejibai.
Conclusion:
This is not a system defect but a user mis-operation, where the Policy Number is being updated manually rather than being linked through the Ejibai interface. Kindly inform the user to avoid such manual updates to prevent duplication issues.
Since no further action is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this incident. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya'}]

We have checked this issue and found that upon adding any lubricant in WO,\xa0*"Outsourcing Lubricant Carry-in"* field is *set to "N" by default* (as per the logic). This field is editable so it can be changed to Y or N after record is created. This logic is same on both uat and prod.
Please confirm if you would like us to:
 * Change the default value to *“Y”* when adding a lubrication record for *all parts*, or
 * Apply this change *only for the two dummy parts*: {{..888888}} and {{..999999}}.
Kindly let us know your preference, or if you have any queries or feedback.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav'}, {'timestamp': '2025-10-29T11:18:00', 'author': 'Service Yoshihara', 'text': 'Hi Atul san
Thanks for the reply.
=>Apply this change only for the two dummy parts: ..888888 and ..999999.
Flag control is correct in UAT-8, so we are letting you know for your reference.
Please adjust the control of UAT-1 to match UAT-8.
Regards,
Service Yoshihara'}, {'timestamp': '2025-10-31T00:00:00', 'author': 'Soham', 'text': "Thank you for your support.
*RCA*:
As discussed in the meeting, this issue occurred due to the execution of the file received for the Lubrication Master (i.e. MFTBCFFR - 4830) for UAT1 and FDP-Okayama. The file contained the value ‘N’ for the Generic Flag field. As a result, the pre-default logic in the Lubrication Master led to the 'Outsourcing Lubricant Carry-in' field being set to ‘N’, since this value is directly derived from the Lubrication Master data.
For Dummy Lubrication Parts, the value of this flag should always be ‘Y’ in the master data.
The recovery has been completed, and we have reset the value of the Generic Flag back to ‘Y’.
*Countermeasure*:
As discussed, whenever the Lubrication Price Master data needs to be uploaded, we kindly request you to:
->Provide only the Price files if updates are required only for the lubrication pricing.
->Provide both Lubrication Master and Lubrication Price Master files if new lubrication data needs to be added in the FDPs.
Additionally, we will update our SOP to include a check for the Generic Flag value for dummy parts whenever a Lubrication Master file is received. We will also inform you in case any data update is required to maintain consistency across systems.
Since this was a data issue and not a system issue, please allow us to close this incident.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Soham"}, {'timestamp': '2025-10-31T06:22:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Hi Soham san,

　Use "Lubricant Price Master".
2. Changes to Lubrication Master (additions or information changes)
　Use "SVC_LUBR_00_209".
　At this time, only provide the changed records.
3. MEMO
The Generic Flag of Dummy Parts # (...888888/...999999) is used for the default display of the Carry-in Flag.
As you commented, this issue is not a system issue, but rather due to incorrect master data settings.
Therefore, we will close this incident.

＜Sample JC#(Quote#)＞
I000233769(@1-QM6B1)
I000235048(@1-QM7BL)
＜Steps I heard＞
1.Selecting Multiple Line Items

Comments:

Best Regards,
Soham"}, {'timestamp': '2025-12-16T09:38:00', 'author': 'Divyesh Ghiya', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
User is performing the following steps in service quote line item while updating the manual discount % in all the line items:
UAT1 test record "1-6WGYRW":
Step 1: Click on an editable field:
Step 2: Now select all lines by clicking "Ctrl+A":
Step 3: Click on Change Records and select the Manual Discount% and enter the field value to be updated for all line items and then click OK:
Step 4: After clicking OK on Change records applet, the editable field in which user clicked in step 1 is changed :
RCA: Change Records is a Siebel Vanilla functionality where it is observed that above steps in all quote line items leads to changing the value in initially selected editable fields. This phenomenon can be observed in other editable fields as well:
Also this is not limited to Service Quotes only, we have replicated the same steps on parts quote too.\xa0
This is a Siebel bug where the change record functionality is behaving in this manner. Current business process configuration is correct but this issue is arising because of the existing Siebel bug,\xa0
Countermeasure: We should inform the users of Hakodate branch to perform such operations on read only fields so that such occurrence can be avoided. Users can click on read only fields or instead of selecting all the fields at once by ctrl+A they can select the records manually(If the cursor is at an editable field). This will ensure that such issue do not occur again.\xa0
Since no further topic is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this ticket. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

Description:
Two JV documents were mixed together in Okayama.
Shipment
O000302256
O000302251
For two shipments of M000442591, when the user clicked the shipped button at almost the same time, the correct detail record was not created within the range of the JV data set separator, and the correct document was not created on the KB side. Please confirm whether there is a way to prevent this problem from occurring.
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2025-10-07T09:48:00', 'author': 'Abhinav', 'text': "Thanks for your support.
We have acknowledged this issue and working on it. We'll provide an update soon.
Meanwhile, please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Abhinav"}, {'timestamp': '2025-10-14T18:31:00', 'author': 'Atul Yadav', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have investigated the root cause and found that the sorting in the Journal Voucher is performed in the order of *Timestamp > Global Order Number > Data Set Separator*. Since both the timestamp and Global Order Number are the same in these cases, the grouping is being done based on the Data Set Separator.
This issue is very rare and has occurred only for a few records in Okayama.
M000204765
 M000244090
 M000303799
 M000315069
 M000364233
 M000401254
 M000433410
 M000442591
Please let us know if recovery is required for these records. If it is required , we will create reverse JV and correct JV in correct sequence.
 As discussed, implementing a fix would require significant changes to the existing logic. Therefore, we kindly request you to close this Jira once recovery has been completed for all affected records.
We will continue to monitor the system daily and perform recovery if any similar cases are detected in the future.
Please let us know if you have any questions or concerns.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav'}, {'timestamp': '2025-10-15T04:24:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': "Recovery of these orders is not necessary.
As I mentioned to Divyesh-san,
I find it strange that this issue only occurs in Okayama.
I'm sure there are similar cases in other FDPs where the Shipped button is repeatedly clicked for different shipments on the same sales order.
Could you please continue to analyze why this issue only occurs in Okayama?
I suspect there is some kind of different setting only in Okayama, where we first went live.
Regards,
Hata"}, {'timestamp': '2025-10-15T12:09:00', 'author': 'Atul Yadav', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

In some FDP environments, the D2S shipment on Sep 25th could not be received.
From D2S team report below.
 
Hi FORCE team,
 
 
With reference to the subject issue, our further analysis indicates that all FDP-related data was stuck in the D2S system due to the following error.
 
Error: *No IDoc saved in target system (SOAP HTTP)*
 
I would like to check whether there was any error or downtime in the FORCE system last night i.e on 25^th^ Sep. Kindly check and confirm.
 
As part of the recovery process, we have resent the affected data.

There was downtime for system on 25th Sept 11 PM JST to 26th Sept 12:00 AM JST as mentioned in the

We have received the file from D2S for PO Allocation and Shipment.
Please check and let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards
Abhinav'}, {'timestamp': '2025-09-28T23:45:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.
Please check with MFTBC IT to see what measures will be taken to prevent the same issue from occurring again.

You can then close this JIRA.
Regards,
Hata'}, {'timestamp': '2025-09-29T14:18:00', 'author': 'Soham', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.

As a countermeasure, we will ensure that interface partners are notified to complete any pending requests beforehand, so that similar issues do not recur. Additionally, we will coordinate with them proactively in case any support is required.
Please allow us to close this incident.
Please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Soham'}]

During peak traffic, prolonged sessions resulted in higher memory utilization and session retention at web layer.

*5. Countermeasure / Preventive Action:*
For any future requirement to extend the session time, it is advised to increase the timeout parameter gradually (e.g., in 10-minute intervals) and monitor system stability after each change.

 We have thoroughly investigated and this issue is same as MFTBCFFR-4243.
 *User Steps:*
 In Revision 1, the Trade-In Flag in NV Quote Header was selected as “Y”.
 However in revision 2, user manually unchecked the flag, changing it to “N”.
 If a user intends to delete the Trade-In Assessment, the correct process is to delete the assessment record first and then uncheck the Trade-In flag.
 *RCA:*
 When the Trade-In flag is unchecked in the NV Quote header, the related Trade-In fields become read-only. This prevents deletion, as certain backend field updates required during deletion cannot occur in this state.
 *Recovery Plan:*
 No recovery action is required. The user can resolve the issue by rechecking the Trade-In flag to “Y”. This will allow deletion of the Trade-In Assessment as needed.
Conclusion:
 This is a case of user mis operation, not a system defect. Hence, kindly allow us to reject this incident.
 Please advise the user to follow the steps outlined above. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
 Atul Yadav'}]

中国環境を確認したところ、持ち込み後付オーダーは添付資料に記載の3つの組織に所属するポジションのユーザーによって作成されておりました。

Summary: SV_JV Branch Code Issue(@Shikoku)
Creator: Yuji Yoshihara
Description:
Hi Service Team,
@Shikoku-PROD
■The Journal Vector Branch Code is different from the JC Workshop Code.
JC＃：I000157195
JC Work Shop Code：23(阿南サービスセンター)
JV Department Code：21(鳴門サービスセンター)
＜JC＞
＜Journal Vector＞
■The reason is that JCO workshop name is 21 (鳴門サービスセンター).
■The JCO Workshop Name will reflect the Branch that first Customer Approved the Quote.
■The issue point for this incident is different between JC Create and the location where the quote was approved.
This means that the correct service price is not being uploaded to KB.
Therefore, change the Workshop Name (Code) of JCO to overwrite the Workshop Name (Code) of Quote by updating the Quote.
Thanks and Regards,
Service Yoshihara

Summary: SV_Changed the logic for setting the posting date of the Re-edit red slip
Creator: Masahiro Hata
Description:
1.*SV**の再編集ボタンクリックによる**JV**赤伝作成時の転記日について**MFTBCFFR-4056**で元のロジックに戻しましたが、月を跨いで再編集が行われると転記日が前月の年月で作成されるため、**KB**インタフェースエラーとなります。*
*この問題がモニタリングしてリカバリを継続しています。*
*恒久対応として転記日のセットロジック以下に変更します。*
l再編集ボタンクリック時に作成するJV Red slip の転記日について。処理日と比較して前回精算日が前月以前の場合、Red slipの転記日には処理月＋1日をセットする。（日は1日固定となる）
l前回精算日の年月と再編集ボタンクリック時年月が同じ場合（当月内）のRed slipの転記日には前回精算日をセットする。現在の仕様通り
lJC画面での毎月１日は再編集ボタンは無効化する。
Comments: [{'timestamp': '2026-01-21T06:30:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support,\nThis was released on 13th September 2025 , with Bulk CR MFTBCFFR-4039 , so we are closing this SR.'}]
Description_enu:
1. Regarding the posting date when creating **JV** Red Den by clicking the *SV** re-edit button, we have returned to the original logic with **MFTBCFFR-4056**, but if re-editing is performed across months, the posting date will be created with the year and month of the previous month, resulting in a **KB** interface error. *
*This issue continues to be monitored and recovered. *
*As a permanent feature, the posting date set logic will be changed to the following. *
l Regarding the posting date of the JV Red slip created when clicking the re-edit button. If the previous settlement date is earlier than the previous month compared to the processing date, set the processing month + 1 day as the red slip posting date. (The day is fixed to 1 day)
lIf the year and month of the previous settlement date and the year and month of clicking the re-edit button are the same (within the current month), set the previous settlement date as the red slip posting date. As per current specifications
The re-edit button on the lJC screen will be disabled on the 1st of every month.

Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2025-06-11T02:45:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have acknowledged this issue and are working on it. We will provide you an update soon.
Meanwhile, let us know if you have any query.
Thanks & Regards
Himanshu'}, {'timestamp': '2025-06-11T12:31:00', 'author': 'Sunaina Gill', 'text': 'Dear Shiromoto-san,
Thank you very much for your support.
Recovery has been completed for the affected record.
We have replicated the issue in the UAT1 environment. Please find the details below:
Reference Record for UAT1
NV SO#: A001295706
PO#: F001295707
AR#: H000047991 (Assessment Purpose: User Purchase)
Upon investigation, we found that an Assessment Request with the assessment purpose set as ‘User Purchase’ can be directly mapped to an NV Quote as a Trade-in Vehicle. This is why the user was able to map the UV Purchase Order to the NV Sales Order.
As a countermeasure, we plan to implement a code change in the process of adding a trade-in vehicle to the NV Quote. After the change, users will only be able to map assessments in NV Quote related to Trade-in assessment purposes only.
Please let us know if you have any concerns or suggestions regarding this approach.
Thank you and best regards,
Sunaina Gill'}, {'timestamp': '2025-06-19T10:42:00', 'author': 'Sunaina Gill', 'text': 'Dear Shiromoto-san,
Thank you very much for your continued support.
As discussed in our meeting, we have implemented a validation message to prevent users from selecting any irrelevant trade-in vehicle in the Quote process. This fix has been applied to both the NV Quote Trade-in and UV Quote Trade-in processes in the UAT environment.
Kindly validate the changes at your convenience and and approve for Prod application.
Please let us know if you have any questions or require further assistance.
Best regards,
Sunaina Gill'}, {'timestamp': '2025-07-11T03:43:00', 'author': 'Himanshu', 'text': 'Thank you for providing Prod approval via mail.
We will release this to Prod environment in next FDP Release scheduled on 24th\xa0July 2025.

This issue has been raised on 19th May at 9:46 AM JST.
As per Oracle recommendation we were using, *coe_Siebel_stats.sql* gather stats script, The script will lock tables with fewer rows. Because of this mentioned tables statistics were locked, and statistics were not collected for the tables.
To fix this issue:\xa0\xa0Unlock stats for above tables, After unlocking run gather stats for above tables.
This issue has been resolved on 19th May at 13:45 JST.
For permanent countermeasure:\xa0We will manually run it once in a month by using DBMS statistics rather than *coe_Siebel_stats.sql* gather stats script.
Please let us know in case of any further query.
Regards
Ashutosh Dogra'}, {'timestamp': '2025-05-20T11:44:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Hi Ashutosh san,

Please Check.
Service Yoshihara'}, {'timestamp': '2025-05-22T03:56:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
Yes your understanding is\xa0 correct. As the quantum of Data was not that much in the tables of Wakayama. Due to which the tables got locked.
And it will be doing to the other tables also in other environments. It was happened in FDP Hakodate also in th emonth of Feb,2025.
The cut-off value was set in the scripts which are recommended and provided by Oracle only.
Therefore we cannot change those values.
hence for Wakayama we are moving to run the stats manually.
Please let us know in case of any further query.
Regards
Ashutosh Dogra'}, {'timestamp': '2025-05-22T04:21:00', 'author': '', 'text': 'いつもお世話になっております。

In the normal process flow, TOB does not accept triggers from the Siebel side after 5:00 PM JST. If a trigger is sent to TOB after 5:00 PM JST and not accepted by TOB then the corresponding records fail in the asynchronous transaction on the Siebel side.  2. Create an Liability Insuracne Quote.

 7. Now the button of "Create Spreadsheet" is enable.
 8. Now Create the Liability Spreadsheet through "Create Spreadsheet" button.
Now We get the commission fee details same Chugoku Production Order.
Fix Plan: We recommend adding one more condition to enable the "Create Spreadsheet" button — the "Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date" should have a valid value before the button is enabled.

よろしくお願いいたします。'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-11T12:47:00', 'author': 'Shivam', 'text': 'Thanks for your continued support.
 We have investigated above issue and below are our findings.
 1. User is able to do the Sales Posting even if the JCO is not created(Service Quote is not "Customer Approved"). As per the current functionality in FDP, there is no check while doing sales positng if there is no JCO. 
 2. As soon as Service Quote status changes to "Customer Approved" JCO is created and now without closing the respective Job Card user will not be able to do the Sales Posting.
In above Sales Order, it seems there is a user mis operation. The user may not have progressed the Service Quote to "Customer Approved", which prevented the creation of JCO. As per FDP's functionality, Sales Posting is still allowed.
In SC version, there is a validation for the first point — when changing the status of a Delivery Request to "Completed", a validation message is displayed.
 Please let us know if we need to implement a similar validation in FDP as well.
Best Regards,
 Shivam'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-11T14:37:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'いつもお世話になっております。

2. 一方、Service Quote のステータスが「Customer Approved」に変更されると JCO が作成され、それ以降は該当する Job Card をクローズしない限り Sales Posting は行えません。
今回の Sales Order については、ユーザー操作の誤りである可能性があります。ユーザーが Service Quote を「Customer Approved」に進めなかったため、JCO が作成されず、その状態でも FDP の仕様上 Sales Posting が許可されたと考えられます。
なお、SC バージョンでは 1 点目のケースに対して、Delivery Request のステータスを「Completed」に変更する際に、検証メッセージが表示される仕様となっています。
FDP においても同様のバリデーションを実装する必要があるか、ご確認のほどお願いいたします。

Sunaina Gill'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-07T10:24:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have completed the recovery process for this record. After thoroughly analyzing the issue, we found in RCA that the parent order ID in the line items (added as parts) remained unchanged, even when the user deleted the previous parts and added new ones. As a result, the user was unable to create a purchase order for the parts.
Please find the Recovery steps below:
1. We have removed the parent order ID from the line items associated with the parts.
2. Kindly ask the user to proceed and create the purchase order.
Kindly let us know in case some further Query.
Best Regards
Sunaina Gill'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-10T03:44:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
\xa0
*RCA*: In this case the sequence of events is as mentioned below: # 
User created order from quote with 2 Part items.
 # 
User created the Parts internal order and then the return order for both the items Part Items.
 # 
User revised the quote.
 # 
Deleted the old items (2 parts) and added the new Part items (2 parts).
The sequence of events happened in such a manner that the same line number was assigned to the new Part Items also. So, when the user synced the Quote and Order.
It got synced with existing part items rather creating new items.
And as the Part orders were already created for the older items. Therefore, the operation got stuck.
As this is a very rare scenario to occur, we request the business team to let us monitor if there is any further such any occurrence in the system to have a better and efficient solution to control this issue.
*Recovery*: Recovery is completed for the affected record.
\xa0
In case of any further query, please let us know.
Regards
Ashutosh Dogra'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-10T08:10:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Dear @Shiromoto, Hideaki (575) San,

ユーザーが2つの部品アイテムを含む見積から注文を作成しました。
ユーザーが「Parts Internal Order」を作成し、その後、両方の部品アイテムに対する「Return order」を作成しました。
ユーザーが見積改訂をしました。
古いアイテム（2つの部品）を削除し、新しい部品アイテム（2つの部品）を追加しました。
このような一連の流れにより、新しい部品アイテムにも同じ行番号が割り当てられました。そのため、ユーザーが見積もりと注文を同期した際に、既存の部品アイテムと同期され、新しいアイテムが作成されませんでした。 さらに、部品注文はすでに古いアイテムについて作成されていたため、操作が停止しました。
この事象は非常に稀なケースであるため、今後同様の事象が発生するかどうかをシステムで監視し、この問題を制御するためのより良い効率的な解決策を見つけるために、ビジネスチームにご確認いただけますようお願い申し上げます。
回復: 影響を受けたレコードについては、回復が完了しました。
ご不明点がございましたら、どうぞお知らせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-10T09:11:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Jiraのステータスが進行中のままですので、クローズできません。'}]

*Fix Plan-1*: Considering the Shipment date will be older than the\xa0 D21Z file execution data. We will compare the Shipment date received in the file to the file execution date and if the Shipment date is greater than the file execution date in the format of *MMDD* then we will take the previous year. Otherwise the current year.\xa0

*Fix Plan 2:* As the Shipment date is already updated by the D21N file. So, the Shipment date updating process from D21Z file will be stopped. This can be done by AMS-CR
*Fix Plan 3*: If TOB can send the year in the D21Z file then we can update the same in the Siebel system.

■ 対応案 
① 修正案1
Shipment DateはD21Zファイルの実行日より過去の日付であることを前提とし、以下のルールで処理を行います。 
Shipment Date（MMDD形式）がファイル実行日より大きい場合：前年を適用
それ以外の場合：当年を適用
この変更はODI側での対応が必要となるため、プロジェクトCRの申請が必要です。
② 修正案2
Shipment DateはすでにD21Nファイルにより更新されているため、D21ZファイルからのShipment Date更新処理を停止する対応です。
この場合、AMS-CRにて対応可能です。

Description:

Branch contacted me to say that the Chassis# (Key#) linked to the JC is different.
It is true that the JC number is the same, but the Chassis# (Key#) is different between the SC version and the FDP version (Chugoku).
My research suggests that there is an issue with the information in the Chassis# of the SC version.
Please work on two topics.
1) Root causes and solutions for differences within VMs
2) Correct Chassis# Recovery in FDP (Chugoku)
JC#：I032547605
＜FDP(Chugoku) Version＞
＜SC Version＞
＜SC Version Vehicle Master＞
Thanks and Regards,
Service Yoshihara
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2025-03-03T14:14:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have acknowledged this issue and are working on it. We will provide you an update soon.
Meanwhile, let us know if you have any query.
Thanks & Regards
Himanshu'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-03T15:17:00', 'author': 'Shivam', 'text': 'Thanks for your continued support.
This is due to inconsistent data in SC Prod.
In Vehicle there are 3 columns, X_KEY, SERIAL_NUM, ASSET_NUM. Ideally these three column should have same value. But In the above case, ASSET_NUM "FK62F-605267", the value in X_KEY and\xa0SERIAL_NUM is "FU74HZ-510966".\xa0
In data migration we have used ASSET_NUM as the user key, and the value in X_KEY and SERIAL_NUM is same as ASSET_NUM in Chugoku Production.\xa0
Please let us know if you have any further query.
Best Regards,
Shivam'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-04T00:44:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'いつもお世話になっております。
こちらの問題はSC Prod内のデータ不整合が原因です。
車両にはX_KEY、SERIAL_NUM、ASSET_NUMの3つのカラムがあり、理想的にはこれらのカラムは同じ値を持つべきです。しかし、上記のケースでは、ASSET_NUM「FK62F-605267」に対して、X_KEYおよびSERIAL_NUMの値は「FU74HZ-510966」となっています。
データ移行時には、ユーザーキーとしてASSET_NUMを使用し、X_KEYおよびSERIAL_NUMの値は中国本番においてASSET_NUMと同じものを使用しました。
その他ご質問がございましたら、お知らせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-04T08:21:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'ヒマンシュさん

よろしくお願いします。

Thank you for your support.
*RCA:*
Currently, our logic retrieves Profit (Sales Price - Cost Price) based on the formula: *Cost Price = Cost * Quantity*, regardless of the DELETE_FLG status in the Datamart database.
However, line items deleted from the Siebel side still exist in the Datamart DB, marked with *DELETE_FLG = 'Y'*, while active line items in Siebel are marked as *DELETE_FLG = 'N'* in Datamart.
Since the PBI report doesn't have a filter to separate deleted line items, causing the difference in Profit values between the PBI report and Siebel.\xa0
*Fix Plan:* 
We are actively working on resolving this issue and expect to implement the fix by *14/03/2025* on UAT.In the meantime, we will proceed with the recovery of impacted records.
Regards,
Sheetal"}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-05T11:21:00', 'author': None, 'text': "城本さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
以下は、Sheetalさんのメールの翻訳になります。
RCA:
現在のロジックでは、DELETE_FLG のステータスに関係なく、以下の計算式で利益 (販売価格 - 原価) を取得しています。
原価 = 原価 × 数量
しかし、Siebel 側で削除された明細は Datamart DB に DELETE_FLG = 'Y' として残り、一方で Siebel 上で有効な明細は Datamart 上で DELETE_FLG = 'N' として管理されています。
PBI レポートには削除された明細を除外するフィルターがないため、PBI レポートと Siebel の間で利益の値に差異が生じていました。
修正計画:
現在、問題の解決に向けて対応を進めており、2025年3月14日までにUAT環境で修正を適用する予定です。
それまでの間、影響を受けたデータのリカバリーを進めてまいります。
ご不明な点がございましたら、お知らせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。"}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-05T17:34:00', 'author': 'Sheetal', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

Please find the attached screenshots of the PBI reports (UV_206 and UV_205) for your reference in the Iwate environment.\xa0\xa0
 The correct profit will be reflected in the Chugoku environment after the report refresh later today.
 
We are actively working on a fix for this issue.
 In the meantime, if the issue occurs again, we will ensure recovery is performed on the same day.

 Sheetal'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-06T05:27:00', 'author': None, 'text': '城本さん、

Description:

発注時は1行のみだったが、明細が50行となっている。

現在、対応中であり、UAT環境でこの問題を再現しようとしています。
宜しくお願い致します。'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-05T12:50:00', 'author': None, 'text': '角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。 
 
本件について詳細に分析した結果、根本原因を特定しました。架装発注に負のコストおよびリスト価格が設定されている場合、販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存され、それが問題を引き起こしていることが判明しました。 
 
以下の手順で問題を再現しました。 
 
**再現手順:** 
1. 見積に架装発注アイテムを追加し、リスト価格とコストの両方を負の値で入力する。 
2. 見積を承認し、その見積を基にオーダーを作成する。 
3. オーダーを承認し、「Create Purchase Order」ボタンをクリックして架装発注の発注書を作成する。 
4. 架装発注の発注書を承認し、その後、見積を修正する。修正後、架装発注オーダーに見積アイテムが同期される。 
 
**根本原因分析 (RCA):** 
「Create Purchase Order」ボタンを使用して架装発注の発注書を作成すると、ワークフローがトリガーされます。しかし、負の価格のバリデーションによってこのワークフローが中断されます。その結果、架装発注オーダーに販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存されます。 
その後、見積を修正すると、同じQuote IDを持つすべての販売オーダーを検索し、行アイテムを同期します。このため、Quote IDを持つ架装発注オーダーの行アイテムも、販売オーダーと一緒に同期されてしまいます。 
 
**UATでの再現:** 
- **架装発注オーダー:** B001292881 (UAT 1) 
- **販売オーダー:** A001292880 (UAT 1) 
 
本件のUAT環境での修正予定日は **3月7日** です。 
 
ご不明点や追加のサポートが必要な場合は、お知らせください。

Please check the RCA for this issue below and Let us know if you have any query.
1.First user created External WO :- 1-E6M77 on 2025/01/29 03:54:31 PM and respective SPO :- J000188523
For this WO Work Start Date/Time is 2025/01/30 06:46:06 PM and Work completion date/time :- 2025/01/30 06:46:08 PM
 
Please note that in SPO Work Start Date/Time and Work completion date/time populated from JC Header.
For JC Header Work Start Date/Time is the Start time of WO in which work is started first (in this case 1-E6M77) and Work completion date/time is Completion time of the Last WO (in this case 1-E4SST, Work completion date/time :- 2025/01/30 06:46:45 PM).
As SPO status set to Completion of Acceptance Inspection JV is created and Posting date in JV has the value of Work completion date/time field of the SPO. 
posting date set to 30/01/2025 for JV of SPO J000188523.
 
2. Now, User created another External WO :- 1-F9HQT on 2025/02/19 01:57:28 PM and respective SPO :- J000192078 in Re-edit mode.
For this WO Work Start Date/Time is 2025/02/19 02:05:03 PM and Work completion date/time :- 2025/02/19 02:05:04 PM.
 
For JC Header Work Start Date/Time is the Start time of first WO (same as before 1-E6M77) and Work completion date/time is Completion time of the Last WO (in this case 1-F9HQT, Work completion date/time :- 2025/02/19 02:05:04 PM).
As SPO status set to Completion of Acceptance Inspection JV is created and Posting date in JV has the value of Work completion date/time field of the SPO. 
posting date still set to 30/01/2025 for JV of SPO J000192078 because Work completion date/time of last WO 1-F9HQT is not set to the JC Header.
 
Work completion date/time in JC Header is updated when user click the Generate Approval button on MF Job Card Detail Applet.
Once user clicked Generate Approval Work completion date/time set to 2025/02/19 02:05:04 PM in JC Header and same date is updated in both the SPO.
Posting Date in JV is correct but in SPO Screen Work Start Date/Time and Work completion date/time coming from from JC Header due to this there is a mismatch in JV and SPO dates.
We have replicated this issue on FDP UAT-1.
Ref. JC :- I001292520
Regards,
Akash'}, {'timestamp': '2025-03-03T10:23:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'いつもお世話になっております。
以下、本件のRCAについてご確認ください。ご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。
RCA
1. *最初の外部WO作成*
 - ユーザーが *2025/01/29 15:54:31* に *外部WO (1-E6M77)* を作成し、対応する *SPO (J000188523)* が生成されました。
 - 本WOの作業開始日時は *2025/01/30 18:46:06、作業完了日時は **2025/01/30 18:46:08* です。
 - SPOの作業開始日時および作業完了日時は *JCヘッダー* から取得されます。
 - JCヘッダーの作業開始日時は、最初に作業が開始されたWO（今回のケースでは *1-E6M77*）の開始時間です。

 * When performing recovery for duplicate recycle fee orders, we check which recycle fee order is mapped to the chassis order and is visible on UI under the chassis order screen.\xa0
 * Furthermore, we check if the TOB status and message is present in the recycle fee order and if so, we consider the one with TOB status and message as the final one and unmap the one that has null value for TOB status and message.
 * All the duplicate recycle fee orders were in 'Pending' status and their TOB status and message was null.
 * Only difference in the duplicate recycle fee orders was their 'Created' date.
 * So we unmapped the recycle fee orders with older 'Created' date and kept the latest 'Created' recycle fee orders that were mapped to the chassis order.\xa0
 * While doing so, we missed the fact that the older 'Created'\xa0recycle fee order could be mapped to a sales order.
 * As a result, we updated the status of the latest 'Created' recycle fee order which was visible on UI and was visible under the chassis order screen and unmapped the older 'Created' recycle fee order from the vehicle, due to which it was also unmapped from the Sales order causing this issue.
As a precautionary measure to avoid such occurrence in the future, we will add one more step in our SOP while checking for duplicate recycle fee orders to check if they are mapped to any Sales order.
Kindly let us know if you have any further queries.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh."}, {'timestamp': '2025-02-07T11:35:00', 'author': None, 'text': '角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
本件について調査を行った結果、Jira\xa0MFTBCFFR-3159\xa0のリカバリーを実施する際に、対象車両に対して重複したリサイクル料金オーダーが存在していることを確認しました。
重複したリサイクル料金オーダーのリカバリーを行う際、どのオーダーがシャシーオーダーにマッピングされ、UI 上のシャシーオーダー画面で表示されているかを確認します。
さらに、リサイクル料金オーダーに TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが存在するかを確認し、存在する場合はそのオーダーを最終的なものとし、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが null のオーダーをアンマップします。
確認したところ、すべての重複したリサイクル料金オーダーは「Pending」ステータスであり、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージは null でした。
これらのオーダーの唯一の違いは「作成日（Created）」だったため、作成日が古いオーダーをアンマップし、最新の作成日のオーダーをシャシーオーダーにマッピングした状態で保持しました。

 Abhishek Singh.'}, {'timestamp': '2025-02-05T00:57:00', 'author': None, 'text': '受注へマップされたことを確認しました'}, {'timestamp': '2025-02-07T11:24:00', 'author': 'Abhishek Singh.', 'text': "We have analyzed this issue and we found that while performing recovery of Jira MFTBCFFR-3159, we had checked that duplicate recycle fee orders were existing for the attached vehicles.
 * When performing recovery for duplicate recycle fee orders, we check which recycle fee order is mapped to the chassis order and is visible on UI under the chassis order screen.\xa0
 * Furthermore, we check if the TOB status and message is present in the recycle fee order and if so, we consider the one with TOB status and message as the final one and unmap the one that has null value for TOB status and message.
 * All the duplicate recycle fee orders were in 'Pending' status and their TOB status and message was null.
 * Only difference in the duplicate recycle fee orders was their 'Created' date.
 * So we unmapped the recycle fee orders with older 'Created' date and kept the latest 'Created' recycle fee orders that were mapped to the chassis order.\xa0
 * While doing so, we missed the fact that the older 'Created'\xa0recycle fee order could be mapped to a sales order.
 * As a result, we updated the status of the latest 'Created' recycle fee order which was visible on UI and was visible under the chassis order screen and unmapped the older 'Created' recycle fee order from the vehicle, due to which it was also unmapped from the Sales order causing this issue.
As a precautionary measure to avoid such occurrence in the future, we will add one more step in our SOP while checking for duplicate recycle fee orders to check if they are mapped to any Sales order.
Kindly let us know if you have any further queries.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh."}, {'timestamp': '2025-02-07T11:35:00', 'author': None, 'text': '角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
本件について調査を行った結果、Jira MFTBCFFR-3159 のリカバリーを実施する際に、対象車両に対して重複したリサイクル料金オーダーが存在していることを確認しました。
重複したリサイクル料金オーダーのリカバリーを行う際、どのオーダーがシャシーオーダーにマッピングされ、UI 上のシャシーオーダー画面で表示されているかを確認します。
さらに、リサイクル料金オーダーに TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが存在するかを確認し、存在する場合はそのオーダーを最終的なものとし、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが null のオーダーをアンマップします。
確認したところ、すべての重複したリサイクル料金オーダーは「Pending」ステータスであり、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージは null でした。
これらのオーダーの唯一の違いは「作成日（Created）」だったため、作成日が古いオーダーをアンマップし、最新の作成日のオーダーをシャシーオーダーにマッピングした状態で保持しました。
しかし、この作業の際に、古い作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーが受注（Sales Order）にマッピングされている可能性を見落としていました。
その結果、UI 上で表示され、シャシーオーダー画面に表示されていた最新の作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーのステータスを更新し、古い作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーを車両からアンマップしました。
これにより、受注からもアンマップされてしまい、本件の問題が発生しました。
今後、同様の問題を防ぐため、重複したリサイクル料金オーダーを確認する際には、それらが受注にマッピングされているかどうかを追加で確認する手順を SOP に追加いたします。

Sheetal"}, {'timestamp': '2025-02-04T07:06:00', 'author': 'Sheetal', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

 We are actively working on the fix and will provide further updates soon.
Regards,
 Sheetal'}, {'timestamp': '2025-02-04T07:21:00', 'author': None, 'text': '角田さん、

重複エントリが原因で、PBIレポートにデータが反映されず、エラーが発生しております。
この問題を解決するには、W_ORDER_Fテーブルから重複エントリを削除するか、フルロードを実施する必要があります。

Summary: PT_EXP_CHRG_TO of Expense return does not match between UI and JV.
Creator: Masahiro Hata
Description:
EXP_CHRG_TO of Expense return does not match between UI and JV.
e.g.)
The user changed EXP_CHRG_TO to 8040 in expense order M000004280 and completed the process.
Return order M000004307 was then created.
Even though the UI shows EXP_CHRG_TO at 8040, the JV department code was created at 8030.
I believe it is also stored at 8030 at the DB level of the order.
Please check this issue.
The JV should be created at 8040 which is the same as the UI display.

[{'timestamp': '2025-01-28T09:05:00', 'author': 'Divyesh Ghiya', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

Divyesh Ghiya'}, {'timestamp': '2025-01-28T11:24:00', 'author': 'Divyesh Ghiya', 'text': "Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
 Expense charge to in Parts Expense Order and Parts expense order is set by Department code of the order creator. In the record mentioned above (Parts Expense Order : M000004280 and Parts Expense Return Order: M000004307), user\xa0D8MAEKAT created these records who have Department code 8030.
While creating Expense order, Department code of the creator is set as Expense charge to in Order. But user san changed the Expense charge to field as 8040 from Order screen. Hence, 8040 department code is set in Parts expense order.
When creating Parts expense return, department code of the creator was set in expense charge to field in parts expense return order which is 8030. On Parts Expense return screen the Expense charge to field shows value of the parent order, that is why 8040 is shown on UI but expense charge to field value in backend in 8030.\xa0
Same mapping logic also exist in SC where Expense Return order shows Expense charge to value of parent order.
In JV, the correct mapping is done where Expense charge to field of the Expense return order is set in\xa0Department Code(CSJS300).\xa0
To sum up, JV mapping is correct but on UI, parent order's Expense charge to field is shown in Expense return order.\xa0
Fix Plan: Either we can change the Expense Charge to field mapping in Expense return order where we will show value of the return order rather than parent order expense charge value or we can change the mapping in JV where we will set Parent Order's expense charge to field value in\xa0Department Code(CSJS300) of Expense Return Order JV line.\xa0
Kindly validate our analysis and let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya"}, {'timestamp': '2025-01-28T11:37:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': 'Thanks for your support.

Himanshu'}, {'timestamp': '2024-12-11T08:19:00', 'author': 'Akash', 'text': 'Thank you for your ongoing support. We have investigated the issue and found that it is due to a user mis-operation. This is related to FDP UAT-1, Reference JC# I001287533.
Here are the steps we followed to replicate the issue:
1.The user created a Work Order (WO), then created and got approval for a quote. After entering the Arrival Date/Time in the Job Card (JC) header, the JC status changed to "Vehicle Arrived."
2.The user drilled down into the WO, started and stopped the work, then clicked on the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button. The WO status changed to "Acceptance Inspection."
3.Since all WOs are now in "Acceptance Inspection" status, the work completion date/time of the last WO was set to the JC's work completion date/time.
4.The user created a new WO with a template, and the customer approved the quote.
5.The user then drilled down into the new WO, started and stopped the work, and tried to click the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button.
However, this action is not allowed in the SC, as the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button is not active in this case. You can refer to SC JC# I026301176 for more details.
Please let me know if you need any further clarification or assistance.
Regards,
Akash'}, {'timestamp': '2024-12-11T12:15:00', 'author': None, 'text': '上のコメントの日本語版
いつもお世話になっております。
ご指摘いただいた問題について調査した結果、ユーザーによる操作ミスが原因であることが判明しました。これはFDP UAT-1に関連しており、参照番号JC# I001287533に関する問題です。
問題を再現するために実施した手順は以下の通りです：
ユーザーはワークオーダー（WO）を作成し、その後見積を作成して承認を得ました。ジョブカード(JC)のヘッダーに到着日時を入力した後、JCのステータスが「車両到着」に変更されました。
ユーザーはWOを開き、作業を開始・終了し、「受け入れ検査設定（Set Acceptance Inspection）」ボタンをクリックしました。その結果、WOのステータスが「受け入れ検査」に変更されました。
現在、すべてのWOが「受け入れ検査」ステータスにあるため、最後のWOの作業完了日時はJCの作業完了日時に設定されました。
ユーザーは新しいWOをテンプレートで作成し、顧客が見積を承認しました。
その後、ユーザーは新しいWOを開き、作業を開始・終了し、「受け入れ検査設定」ボタンをクリックしようとしました。
ただし、この操作はSCでは許可されておらず、今回の場合、「受け入れ検査設定」ボタンがアクティブではありません。詳細についてはSC JC# I026301176をご参照ください。
さらなるご説明やサポートが必要な場合は、お知らせください。
宜しくお願い致します。'}, {'timestamp': '2024-12-19T03:28:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'ヒマンシュさん
お疲れ様です。
