Summary: KB_Bulk invoice data not created
Creator: Hajime Miyauchi
Description:
Change order# : K000252165
Bill to Account# : 0000118770
Bolk invoice data not created on 20th Nov.
Please fix and recovery asap.
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2024-11-22T07:55:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Dear Miyauchi San,
Thank you for your support.
We are working on this issue and we will update you as soon as possible.
Thanks
Amit'}, {'timestamp': '2024-11-25T09:16:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Dear Miyauchi San,
Thank you for your support.
RCA : We have investigated the issue and we found that SMDO001 in Bulk Invoice is mapped with Last Updated date in case of Service Change Order.
As per the normal Process whenever the status of Service Change Order is set to Approved the order becomes Read Only. The Last Updated date is the same as Posting Date.
For this Order the Last Updated Date was changed to 6 Nov 2024 which was different from Posting Date due to some backend process and SMDO001 was set to 20241106.
I have attached the supporting screenshort.
Fix Plan : We will make a new Field to store the Approved Date and we will map that date Field with SMDO001 in Bulk Invoice for Service Change Order.
Please check and let us know for any queries.
Thanks
Amit'}, {'timestamp': '2024-11-26T06:32:00', 'author': None, 'text': '上のコメントの日本語版いつもお世話になっております。
RCA（根本原因分析）
この度の問題について調査を行った結果、サービスチェンジオーダーにおいて、一括請求書（Bulk Invoice）のSMDO001が最終更新日とマッピングされていることがわかりました。
通常のプロセスでは、サービスチェンジオーダーのステータスが「承認済み」に設定されると、その注文は「読み取り専用」となります。この際、最終更新日（Last Updated Date）はPosting Dateと同じになります。
しかし、この注文については、最終更新日が2024年11月6日に変更され、Posting dateとは異なり、バックエンドプロセスによりSMDO001が20241106に設定されました。
関連するスクリーンショットを添付いたしますので、ご確認ください。
修正計画
承認日を格納する新しいフィールドを作成し、その日付フィールドをサービスチェンジオーダーの一括請求書におけるSMDO001とマッピングいたします。
ご確認の上、何かご不明点がございましたらお知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願い申し上げます。'}, {'timestamp': '2024-12-10T06:11:00', 'author': None, 'text': 'Thank you for your support.

Issue:- UV In-Box Approval Error.
RCA:- User steps are as follows:-
1. Created Quote '1-1WQC6R' revision 1 and approved the quote.
2. Created Sales Order 'E000247317'.
3. Generated Approvals of sales order by clicking on "Generate Approval" button.
4. Sales Order status left in "Pending Approval" as user has not approved the sales order.
5. User created a new quote with revision 2 by clicking on "Revise" button and approved the quote.
6. As Sales order was left in 'Pending Approval' status, by approving quote '1-1WQC6R' revision 2, Sales order status was set to "Cancelled".
7. Then user tried to Reject/Approve the sales order but it was not possible to Reject/Approve it because Sales order status can not be changed from "Cancelled" to "Rejected/Approved".
 
Fix Plan:-No Fix required. As the issue occured due to user mis operation.
In the above scenario:-
Either User should approve the Sales Order first and then should revise the quote, Or User should create a new Sales order instead of using the cancelled sales order.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Thanks and regards,
Laxminarayan Meena.'}, {'timestamp': '2024-11-07T15:56:00', 'author': None, 'text': '城本様、
お世話になっております。
問題: UVインボックス承認エラー
原因調査 (RCA): ユーザーステップは以下の通りです：
1．見積-1-1WQC6R(改訂版1)を作成し、見積を承認しました。
2．受注「E000247317」を作成しました。
3．「承認依頼」ボタンをクリックして、受注の承認を生成しました。
4．ユーザーが受注を承認しなかったため、受注は「承認待ち」の状態のままでした。
5．ユーザーは「改訂」ボタンをクリックして、新しい見積（改訂版2）を作成し、見積を承認しました。
6．受注が「承認待ち」の状態のままだったため、見積-1-1WQC6R(改訂版2)を承認すると、受注のステータスは「キャンセル済み」となりました。
7．その後、ユーザーは受注を「却下」または「承認済み」しようとしましたが、受注のステータスが「キャンセル済み」から「却下」または「承認済み」に変更できる可能性がなかったため、できませんでした。
修正計画: 修正は不要です。問題はユーザーの操作ミスによるものです。
上記のシナリオでは: ユーザーはまず受注を承認し、その後見積を改訂する必要があります。または、キャンセルされた受注を使用する代わりに、新しい受注を作成するべきです。

Summary: PT_Parts Quote Approval flow create issue
Creator: Masahiro Hata
Description:
Parts Quote Approval flow create issue.
In FDP-UAT1, Quote Num  1-5HYOLS
When 0% was entered in the override less %, an approval flow was created.
It is incorrect that an approval flow was created even though a value lower than the 10% set in the discount master was entered.
If 1% had been entered, it would have been correctly approved automatically.
Please check this issue.
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2024-10-08T08:46:00', 'author': 'Akash', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
We have acknowledged this incident and are working on it. We will provide you an update soon. 
Meanwhile, please let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Akash'}, {'timestamp': '2024-10-08T13:21:00', 'author': 'Akash Gupta', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
I wanted to clarify that for local parts approval, the criteria are based on the cost ratio rather than the discount rate. In the current quote, which includes a local part as a line item, the cost ratio is set at 100.
When a parts staff member requests a quote with a local part, the approval condition requires the cost ratio to be between 0 and 105, with the customer type designated as "customer." Under these conditions, the approval should indeed go to the Branch Parts Manager, which aligns with the intended process.
If there are any further questions or adjustments needed, please let me know.
Best regards,
Akash Gupta'}, {'timestamp': '2024-10-09T08:07:00', 'author': 'Hata', 'text': 'Hi Akash san
The LPP res set in the discount master for this customer is 10%.
 When a part number is entered, the sales price is determined based on this master.
 The cost rate calculation is based on the Sales Price and the Cost price.
 Therefore, if you enter an overwritten Less or an overwritten price that is higher than this Sales Price, it will not be subject to the approval flow.
 Currently, If 1% is entered for the Less Overwrite Less for this part number, it is automatically approved, but only when 0% is entered, an approval flow is created.
 Why is it automatically approved when 1% is entered?
Regards,
Hata'}, {'timestamp': '2024-10-09T15:14:00', 'author': 'Akash', 'text': 'Dear Hata san,
 
Thank you for your ongoing support.
This issue is a data issue present only on UAT environment not on prod(we have checked it on RT2 Quote# 1-E26NK6 there it is working correctly).
this has been fix on UAT-1.

We investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
The issue occurred because D21F file received on 20 Aug evening was not processed in ODI.
During the recovery of incident MFTBCFFR-2441, we were re-running D21E files in Aomori Prod environment. At that time, D21F file was present in the Inbound folder, we were checking the data of the files and opened D21F file too, this caused D21F not be latest file on path. When ODI package was executed, it searched for the latest file and no file was detected. 
Countermeasure: We generally do not perform recovery of D21 files, but for the future we have added an extra step to not open additional files present in the Inbound folder.
Recovery is completed now on prod and recycle fee data is shown correctly. Please allow us to close the incident.
Please let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya'}, {'timestamp': '2024-08-23T04:40:00', 'author': None, 'text': '上のメールの日本語版さん、

MFTBCFFR-2441のインシデントリカバリー作業中に、青森の本番環境でD21Eファイルの再処理を行っていました。その際、D21Fファイルがインバウンドフォルダー内に存在し、ファイルのデータを確認してD21Fファイルも開いたため、D21Fファイルがパス上で最新のファイルではなくなりました。その結果、ODIパッケージが実行された際に最新のファイルを検索し、ファイルが検出されませんでした。

The Trade-in assessment# H000004008 was included in NV Quote# 1-UJYUK. Revision 2 of NV Quote# 1-UJYUK was attached to order# A000109884, which was subsequently rejected. When the user created and approved revision 3 of NV Quote# 1-UJYUK, the synchronization process from the NV quote to the NV sales order generated PO# F000110671. Best Regards,
Sunil Kumar'}, {'timestamp': '2024-08-08T05:37:00', 'author': 'Sunil Kumar', 'text': "Thank you for your support.
We have found rca of this issue and are describing below step by step:-
For NV Case:
1.The user created an NV Quote with a Trade-In and used the auto-order button to generate an NV Sales Order, which initially had a status of 'Pending'.
2.The user then clicked the 'Generate Approval' button for the NV Sales Order but rejected the approval, resulting in the NV Sales Order status being updated to 'Rejected'.
3.The user revised the NV Quote (Revision 1) to NV Quote (Revision 2) and approved NV Quote (Revision 2).
4.NV Quote (Revision 2) synchronized with the NV Sales Order, triggering the creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.
5.Since the Auto Order button is enabled in NV Quote (Revision 2), the user can generate a new NV Sales Order by clicking it.
Even though the NV Sales Order is in a 'Rejected' status, a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In will created.
For UV Case:

2.Revise UV Quote(Revision 1) to UV Quote(Revision 2) and approved UV Quote(Revision 2)
3.UV Quote (Revision 2) synchronized with the UV Sales Order, triggering the creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.

Summary: SV_1-10A_settlement_date
Creator: Megumi Nakane
Description:
in FDP SV PBI 1-10A report, settement date in below JC was wrong.
JC#：I000097002(Change Order＃：K000121869)
in PBI 1-10A report, settelement date for this JC was 18th March.
and when we check PBI and Siebel today, it is 19th March.(which is correct)
why settlement date was 18th March?
could you check the logic behind?
Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2024-03-22T04:11:00', 'author': 'Sheetal', 'text': 'Dear Nakane San,
Thank you for your support.
This is acknowledged and we are working on it.
Regards,
Sheetal'}, {'timestamp': '2024-03-25T10:46:00', 'author': 'Sheetal', 'text': 'Dear Nakane San,
 
Thank you for your support.
 
RCA : The settlement date in the PBI updates the LAST_UPD date of the Service Change Order. 
 
Initially, when the JC#：I000097002(Change Order＃：K000121869) was created on March 18th, the LAST_UPD date was set as March 18th. 
 
Subsequently, on March 19th, when the JC#：I000097002(Change Order＃：K000121869) was updated, the LAST_UPD date changed to March 19th, and this update was also reflected in the PBI. So 19th March is correct.
 
Kindly let us know for more explanations.
 
Regards,
 
Sheetal'}, {'timestamp': '2024-03-26T07:13:00', 'author': 'Nakane', 'text': "Dear Khare-san
Thank you for your support.
our understaiding for mapping for 'settlement date' for change order is different.
there is column called 'Change Order Completion date' on Siebel side and
we should have that column for 'settlement date' in PBI.
if we map 'last updated date' in settlement date, then just 'in progress' CO (which is just created and not approved yet) will also have settelement date and would be displayed in PBI reports.
which is not correct. only approved CO should have settlement date and be displayed in PBI. is our requirement. could you check?
Best Regards,
Nakane"}, {'timestamp': '2024-03-26T07:36:00', 'author': 'Sheetal', 'text': 'Dear Nakane San,
Thank you for your support.
This is acknowledged and we are checking.
We will provide update soon.
Regards,\xa0
Sheetal'}, {'timestamp': '2024-03-27T16:23:00', 'author': 'Sheetal', 'text': "Dear Nakane San,
Thank you for your support.
After analysis the PBI 1_10A Report, it appears that there are differences between the logic used in Siebel and the logic implemented in PBI 1_10A. In Power BI, \xa0'in progress' CO (recently created but not yet approved) also includes a settlement date.
To align with the Siebel logic, we need to add some changes for Settlement Date in PBI SV_1_10A .Therefore, a strategic work plan is necessary to address this challenge effectively.\xa0
Hence, we request you to raise an AMS-CR for this incident.
Regards,
 Sheetal"}]

Comments:
[{'timestamp': '2024-01-23T09:24:00', 'author': 'Khushi Mulge.', 'text': 'Thank you for your support.
RCA for this incident:
For UV SO# E000087121, the steps user has followed: 
1. User had filled the Approval Date manually in More Info of UV Sales Order Screen. 
2. Then User has generate approval.
3. The Sales Order was rejected by Branch Head.
4. So the status is rejected, but since Approval Date is filled, SO is showing in Order Report.
Usually, Approval Date field is auto populated, when the approvers approve the Sales Order. 
On the Sales Order Reporting screen, the Approved Orders are filtered on basis of Approved Date.
As for UV SO# E000037797, the steps user has followed: 
1. The user had filled the Delivery Completion Approved Date manually in the Sales Posting section of UV Sales Order screen. 
2. And then user has generated Approval.
3. This field is populated when Delivery Request is completed. 
On the Sales Order Reporting screen, the Sales Posting Completed Orders are filtered on basis of Delivery Completion Approved Date. 
Due to this, the SO is showing in Sales Report.
Let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Khushi Mulge.'}, {'timestamp': '2024-01-25T01:15:00', 'author': None, 'text': '城本さん、
 
お世話になっております。
 
本インシデントの原因分析です:

Divyesh Ghiya'}, {'timestamp': '2024-01-10T12:33:00', 'author': 'Divyesh Ghiya', 'text': 'We investigated this issue thorughly and below are our findings:
In Sales Order, tax percent comes from the sales quote but there is a logic written behind Generate Approval button. In this logic, Whenever user clicks generate approval, tax rate is being searched in Consumption Tax Master in following manner:
First, query by acknowledgment date in consumption master, 
if acknowledgment date is >= Today then:
Condition 1: Last Contract Date <= Acknowledgment Date
Condition 2: Last Contract Date >= Acknowledgment Date
else,
Condition 3: acknowledgment date < Today
For condition 1 and 3, we then query start date <= Last Contract Date <= End Date
For condition 2, we query start date <= Planned Delivery Date <= End Date
In FDP-Okayama, Acknowledgment date is 2020/11/30(which is less then today), so condition 3 will be followed and query will be done on the basis of Last Contract Date in Sales Order. In all the orders we shared with you, you can find that last contract date was less then start date(2023/07/29), hence there were 0 results of the query and tax percent was set to null.
*This logic is same as in SC.*
We replicated the same test case in SC UAT1 where se set Last Contract Date(2018/01/31) less then Start Date (2020/11/30) in Order A025013709. In this case also, tax percent was set to null and order sheet bip was failed.
one solution to avoid this in FDP is to set Start Date same as SC so that query will not give null result and tax percent is set properly.
Kindly, confirm this RCA and let us know if you have any query.

Description:

However, print solution logs cannot solve the network-related areas alone.

check list

 *    pktmon behavior should not affect performance

 ### pktmon filter add -i 53.84.103.246 -t tcp -p 9100

It seems that he forgot to clear the product book value on the vehicle master side when canceling H000000001.
During normal restocking, the product book value in the vehicle master is cleared.

Summary: 税率０％の仕訳データの税率が１０％として画面上表示される。
Creator: Masato Watanabe
Description:
・回避策について、OBCに確認する。
　⇒4/21　OBCからの回答で対応を検討する。
＝＝＝OBC回答＝＝＝
【1：非課税取引である場合】
原因は「税区分」が指定されていない為です。
これにより勘定科目の初期値である「課税仕入」という税区分にて仕訳登録されていると思われます。
まず、勘定奉行では課税取引で税率０％という仕訳伝票は登録できません。
これが非課税取引であるならば、税計算が不要なのでこの場合が税率０％といえます。
よって、今回仕訳例で添付いただいた「部品」などの勘定科目は通常課税取引ですが、
今回だけ非課税取引（＝０％）として仕訳登録するような場合は
借方税区分（CSJS203）に明示的に非課税仕入の税区分コードである「1」を明示的にセットしてください。
【2：消費税額を別計上している場合】
頂いた仕訳の例が、課税取引ではあるけれど、消費税金額は別明細で計上しているので
消費税額が入っていなければ0%ではないかということであれば、これは受領した仕訳で問題ないとの回答になります。
消費税金額が明細に無くとも、消費税計算上は本体科目が10%の課税対象額となるので、
こちらは10%と表示されるのが正しい状態です。
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
Summary_enu: Journal data with a tax rate of 0% is displayed on the screen as a tax rate of 10%.
Description_enu:
・Confirm with OBC regarding workarounds.
⇒4/21 We will consider measures based on the response from OBC.
===OBC answer===
[1: If it is a tax-exempt transaction]
The cause is that the "tax classification" is not specified.
As a result, the journal entry is likely to be registered under the tax category "Taxable Purchase", which is the initial value of the account.
First of all, in Account Bugyo, you cannot register a journal entry slip with a tax rate of 0% for taxable transactions.
If this is a tax-free transaction, no tax calculation is required, so the tax rate in this case can be said to be 0%.
Therefore, although the account items such as "Parts" attached in this journal entry example are normally taxable transactions,
If you want to register a journal entry as a tax-exempt transaction (=0%) only this time,
Please explicitly set the debit tax classification (CSJS203) to "1", which is the tax classification code for non-taxable purchases.
[2: If the consumption tax amount is recorded separately]
The example journal entry you received is a taxable transaction, but the consumption tax amount is recorded in a separate statement.
If the amount is 0% if the consumption tax amount is not included, then the answer is that there is no problem with the journal entry received.
Even if the consumption tax amount is not included in the statement, the main item will be subject to 10% tax when calculating consumption tax.
The correct state is to display 10%.
============

Summary: 【CR】交換部品管理手数料とマイナーパーツの計算ロジック変更
Creator: Tatsuya Ishikawa
Description:
*+開発要件(計算ロジック変更) +*
*(1)指定金額の追加 *
(1-1)交換部品管理費用取得フラグとマイナーパーツ取得フラグを"Y"にすることで計算マスタから料金を算出する。 
(1-2)ただし，"交換部品管理金額"と"マイナーパーツ金額"に金額が手入力されている場合は，計算マスタからの算出は行わずに見積金額を反映する。 
 交換部品管理金額：項目番号"YS5A"のList Priceに反映
 マイナーパーツ金額：項目番号"YS4A"のList Priceに反映
(1-3)項目(1-2)の実現するために"交換部品管理金額"と"マイナーパーツ金額"のフィールドを編集可能に変更する(形式は金額) 
(1-4)見積作成後，"交換部品管理金額"と"マイナーパーツ金額"フィールドを変更した場合は，見積を更新するようエラーメッセージを表示する 
 JPN：交換部品管理金額またはマイナーパーツ金額が変更されています。見積を再作成してください。
 ENU：The Trustee Fee or Minor Part Fee has Changed. Please Recreate the Quote.
(1-5)"交換部品管理金額"と"マイナーパーツ金額"フィールドの有効な金額は1円以上，0円 or nullの場合は交換部品管理費用取得フラグとマイナーパーツ取得フラグが"N"のケースと同じである。 
 
*(2)部品定価金額の計算方法変更(計算除外部品の対応) *
(2-1)現在は見積の【製品タイプ】の部品+アクセサリ+油脂となっている項目のList Priceを合計している。 
(2-2)List Price合計の計算方法は同じであるが，新たに【計算対象】のフィールド(Y/Nフラグ)を追加し，【計算対象】が"Y"場合のみ【製品タイプ】の部品+アクセサリ+油脂のList Priceを合計する。 
 (【計算対象】が"N"場合は合計に含まない)
(2-3)【計算対象】のフィールド(Y/Nフラグ)の切替え操作について(Cubastionと要相談) 
 ①希望は見積でフラグの操作を行いたい
 ②List Priceの合計計算が困難または再作成時の明細の維持が困難な場合はWOでフラグの操作を行う
(2-4)見積で【計算対象】フィールドの追加に伴い，WOにも同じ項目名でフィールドを追加する(対象：パーツタブと油脂タブ) 
 フラグのデフォルト設定
 パーツ/アクセサリー：Y
 油脂：Y
(2-5)見積作成後，【計算対象】フィールドを変更した場合は，見積を更新するようエラーメッセージを表示する 
 フィールドの変更チェックについてはQuote Statusが"Pending"の時までチェックを行い、メッセージを表示する

(1-5) Valid amounts in the "Replacement parts management amount" and "Minor parts amount" fields are 1 yen or more, and if they are 0 yen or null, it is the same as the case where the replacement parts management cost acquisition flag and minor parts acquisition flag are "N". 
 
*(2) Change in the calculation method of parts list price (corresponding to parts excluded from calculation) *
(2-1)Currently, the list prices of the [product type] parts + accessories + oils and fats in the estimate are totaled. 
(2-2) The calculation method for the list price total is the same, but a new [calculation target] field (Y/N flag) is added, and the list prices of [product type] parts + accessories + oils and fats are totaled only when [calculation target] is "Y".
